item.title: The job market
item.description: Language for job hunting, applications, contracts and career moves.

children.definition: a job that is available for someone to do
children.example: The company has two vacancies for junior developers.

children.definition: a person who formally asks for a job or a place on a course
children.example: Over a hundred applicants applied for the internship.

children.definition: to choose a small group of the best people from everyone who applied
children.example: I was shortlisted and invited to a final interview.

children.definition: a short period of work, often for students, to gain experience in a job
children.example: Her summer internship at an IT company turned into a full-time offer.

children.definition: the things a person or company has achieved in the past
children.example: She has a strong track record of delivering projects on time.

children.definition: a first period in a new job when your employer checks that you are suitable
children.example: There is a three-month probation before the contract becomes permanent.

children.definition: working for several clients on separate projects, not for one employer
children.example: He works as a freelance designer for clients in Europe.

children.definition: to find a person working for another company and offer them a job
children.example: She was headhunted by an international bank last year.

children.definition: extra things you get from a job in addition to your pay
children.example: The perks include free lunch and English lessons.

children.definition: abilities that are useful in many different kinds of work
children.example: Teaching gave me transferable skills like planning and public speaking.

children.definition: the series of jobs from lower to higher positions in a profession
children.example: He moved up the career ladder quickly and now leads a team.
collocations: the bottom of the career ladder

children.definition: the time you must keep working after you say you are leaving a job
children.example: My notice period is one month, so I can start in March.
